scope: Local synthetic three-process deployment; real browser UI, not mocked API

binaryPackage.name: @sparticuz/chromium
binaryPackage.installation: Scratch-only test tooling; not a product runtime dependency

assertions.name: MFA, provisioned encrypted vault and approved device binding
Endpoint encrypted text, policy-gated release, verified decryption and acknowledgement
Hostile HTML-shaped message displayed as text without script execution
Simulated disconnect, encrypted queue, policy denial and reconnection HOLD
Explicit policy allow and subsequent controlled release
Browser storage excludes plaintext message, private signing key and bootstrap credentials
Real browser offline network toggle, cached-shell reload, encrypted vault unlock and local creation
Fresh MFA required before reconnecting after reload
Modified device signing challenge rejected before an enrollment proof is sent
Encryption-key substitution after enrollment signing rejected by server body-binding check
Fresh browser key generation, enrollment, approval gate and successful binding
Two actual browser tabs serialize vault writes through Web Locks; one commits and stale peer is rejected

initialFailures.finding: Standard Playwright Chromium archive download returned invalid or truncated ZIP
initialFailures.resolution: Installed a separate npm-packaged Chromium test binary; no runtime dependency was added

initialFailures.finding: Archive extraction attempted unsupported ownership changes
initialFailures.resolution: Extracted test archives with tar --no-same-owner into scratch tooling directory

initialFailures.finding: Separate execution cells isolated loopback listeners
initialFailures.resolution: Spawned services and browser runner from one test orchestrator

initialFailures.finding: Policy select labels included option text and failed exact accessibility lookup
initialFailures.resolution: Used explicit input IDs with separate label elements; reran complete browser scenario successfully

visualReview.status: Inspected; no clipping, overlap or material layout problem observed at 1440px viewport

securityReviewFixes.finding: Device signing accepted arbitrary server challenge content
securityReviewFixes.fix: Exact schema, domain, purpose, operation, device, request hash and expiry validation before signing
securityReviewFixes.validation: Focused negative unit cases and actual browser altered-challenge rejection before proof POST

securityReviewFixes.finding: A signed non-release receipt with matching digests could pass partial receipt checks
securityReviewFixes.fix: Require RELEASE_ISSUED/RELEASED and matching actor, recipient, device, object and action
securityReviewFixes.validation: Focused negative unit cases and successful actual browser delivery

securityReviewFixes.finding: localStorage compare-before-write alone was not atomic across tabs
securityReviewFixes.fix: Exclusive cooperative Web Lock around comparison and synchronous encrypted write; unsupported browsers fail closed
securityReviewFixes.validation: Focused unit cases and actual simultaneous two-tab browser test
